headlines.title: Vance says there’s ‘no daylight’ between him and Trump on the Iran war
headlines.description: JD Vance on Monday said he and President Donald Trump are totally aligned on the Iran war after the vice president this month attributed Republicans’ electoral beatdown in the midterm elections to voter frustrations with the conflict.

headlines.title: Trump took Qatari jet to Asia, but it’s unclear whether it’s been ‘maxed out’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump, who is traveling in Asia this week, arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday on the Air Force One gifted by Qatar as questions linger about upgrades the White House said were needed after a security threat from Iran forced the president to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane in July, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Trump Arrives in Asia for Historic Meeting With Xi Jinping and Putin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump touched down in the Philippines on Tuesday for a summit with Southeast Asian nations ahead of his meeting with his counterparts from Russia and China on Thursday. It comes as the president is now suggesting his three-day trip might also include a conversation with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump heads overseas for meeting with Putin, Xi
headlines.description: President Trump is headed to Asia for a meeting with the leaders of China and Russia, and a potential meeting with Kim Jong Un. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Israeli & Palestinian activist duo see new hope for peace after Israeli and U.S. elections
headlines.description: Maoz Inon, an Israeli activist, and Aziz Abu Sarah, a Palestinian activist, join Meet the Press NOW for an NBC News Common Ground conversation on how recent elections in Israel and the U.S. could be a hopeful step toward peace.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. James Comer announces bid for Kentucky governor
headlines.description: Rep. James Comer, R-Ky., announced Monday night that he is running for governor of Kentucky in an attempt to flip the governor’s mansion from blue to red in 2027.

headlines.title: U.S. attorney warns Sen. Elizabeth Warren against investigating Trump associates
headlines.description: U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Texas Aaron Reitz has sent similar letters to Sen. Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut and Elissa Slotkin of Michigan.

headlines.title: An early look at the 2028 Senate map: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur dives into the next battle for the Senate.

headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he “would not mind” Jensen Huang being reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he resigned.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects challenge to Maryland’s ‘sensitive places’ gun ban
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court on Monday declined to hear a broad challenge to Maryland’s restrictions on people carrying firearms in a broad range of public areas.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump over academic funding cuts related to DEI
headlines.description: The Supreme Court rejected President Donald Trump’s move to abruptly cancel academic funding for researchers in California over his opposition to DEI initiatives.
